native_evaluation.methodology: Controlled PDF edits plus selected positive/unchanged checks on four official IRS revisions. Not exhaustive natural-revision precision/recall.

character_conservation.methodology: Multiset comparison with Pdfium character stream after NFC, explicit ligature expansion, and whitespace/control/soft-hyphen filtering. Legacy rectangle queries are reproduced by the audit example; this is not independent Unicode ground truth.

browser_runtime.methodology: All-page native/WASM text order after whitespace removal, dimensions, rotation and view boxes; first-page PNG and viewport. Also 24 painted marker projections within 1px, rendering limits, three malformed/geometry sources, diff API and invalid-input recovery. No native/WASM pixel-equivalence claim.

checks.wasm_build: release WASM probe built and run in actual Chrome
checks.runtime_bootstrap: checksum verification, archive extraction and build tested
checks.workflow_yaml: parsed with Ruby Psych; native matrix and browser gate verified
checks.remote_ci: not dispatched; Linux gate remains unverified

readiness.evidence: Ubuntu native test gate with fontconfig and CJK fallback fonts added; not executed in this macOS session.
Four edition pairs with 25 selected checks; exhaustive labels and precision/recall on broader natural revisions are missing.
Current IR and comparison do not cover images, drawings, font face/color, interactive field values or annotations. Partial scans can contain only a logo text layer.

PageIr.view_box, PageSize.view_box and RenderedPage.viewport added. Native 48 and browser 24 independently painted renders verified within 1px; shifted CropBox regression on all 43 public documents. Physical UserUnit scaling remains outside this gate.
Public option effectiveness audit remains; text_change_score is still declared/defaulted without a matching use.
Invalid bytes/arguments and ordinary resource limits tested; broader encrypted, damaged and decompression-bomb corpus coverage remains.
UserUnit=3 projects correctly to current Pdfium bitmaps, but physical page-size/DPI scaling and changes only to UserUnit are not detected. Documented as unsupported.

geometry_evaluation.native_oracle: Actual PNG pixels plus Pdfium PageToDevice API
geometry_evaluation.browser_oracle: Canvas reads PNG pixels; DOMMatrix applies public coefficients
geometry_evaluation.conditions: Four rotations; inherited boxes; nonzero, negative and 100000-unit origins; fractional dimensions; CropBox/MediaBox intersection; UserUnit=3 as rendered by Pdfium.
geometry_evaluation.limits: Projection to the current Pdfium renderer, not physical UserUnit support or arbitrary-coordinate precision.
geometry_evaluation.regressions: Crop-only origin edit, header-only and textless page matching, duplicate-page geometry tie, off-page clipping, legacy OCR JSON and render size limits.
